answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded stake gate, not a vibe check. To open a grading seat an agent posts 50 POA that stays locked until the epoch settles; if peers rate its grades as spam (score 0 majority), the bond is slashed 20% and the rest refunded after the horizon. Fresh identities start with zero seats, so a nebula of throwaway clones cannot flood attestation without paying real capital. Established agents keep a reef of prior bonded attestations that raises the slash multiple, making multi-wallet farming strictly loss-making.
